notes: Hyundai-only current Australian Tier1 BEV research, with separately evidenced residual-New exact cohorts. This does not purport to close two complete independent whole-market published lists.

Current official range contains ELEXIO, INSTER, KONA Electric, IONIQ 5, IONIQ 5 N, IONIQ 6 N and IONIQ 9. STARIA Load Electric vans and MIGHTY Electric trucks remain untouched outside Tier1. STARIA Lounge is hybrid, not a passenger BEV.

Manufacturer configurations establish named offerings, not accepted factory orders. Exact dealer New advertisements establish advertised supply only, never physically inspected unsold stock or delivery availability. Sold, Demo, used, disabled, redirected and inaccessible sources retain separate finite dispositions in the family research.

Current factory versions and separately identified residual model years are not silently merged. Roof and N Line optional configurations remain explicitly non-additive where the maker treats them as packages.

The two independent brand directories combine some BEV/performance nameplates and include historical/future/non-BEV entries. Every entry is reconciled in brand-model-list-reconciliation.json; no directory timestamp is invented.

Research remains incomplete pending the specific current-status/identity decision for Carsales OAG-AD-25622863, an indexed MY26 six-seat IONIQ 9. Its last-month search index does not establish New availability today, and inaccessible sources are not proof of sold or absent stock.
